description: She wears a floor-length ivory gown with a square neckline, narrow decorated shoulder sections and a fitted bodice densely edged in gold geometric embroidery. Gold patterned borders continue down the front and around the hem. Rust-red outer fabric with broad gold embroidery drapes around her arms and descends as an open robe-like layer with a small train. A dark red sash belt with round gold medallions carries hanging gold tassel ornaments. A jeweled gold pendant necklace, filigree drop earrings, wrist cuff and ring are visible, with a gold-brown embroidered closed shoe below the hem.
